name: Komi
source:
Komi is the protagonist's best friend... except she's not real - she's an original character he made up when he was 15!

Outgoing, friendly, and always positive. She represents the side of him that he rejects to protect himself - his femininity, innocence, hope and positivity.

Only Syun can see and hear Komi. How lonely...

[From [url=https://meiri.itch.io/doce-fim]official profile[/url]]
